name: weave_get_model_run_output
description: Gets the output and status of Weave model runs started with weave_run_model. Pass the `predictionIds` those calls returned. This is for model runs only — for a run of a Weave tool (a published Weave workflow) use weave_get_tool_run_output instead. Poll this after weave_run_model to track progress and read the output. The response also includes curl instructions for downloading the outputs — the URL+curl path is strongly preferred because it uses far fewer tokens than embedding media inline.

predictionIds.description: The prediction ids to fetch output for, as returned by weave_run_model.
